parsed.name: 电动激光功率控制器
parsed.description: 一种通过电动旋转机构调节光学元件角度来控制激光输出功率的装置。它通常用于在实验中连续、可重复地调节激光强度，便于进行功率扫描、光路对准和样品照射强度控制。
parsed.description_en: A device that controls laser output power by motorized rotation of an optical element. It is typically used in laboratory experiments for continuous, repeatable laser intensity adjustment, enabling power sweeps, optical alignment, and controlled sample illumination.
